newsitem.title: USA: Applied Magnetics stake cut by Vinik group.
newsitem.headline: Applied Magnetics stake cut by Vinik group.

text.p: A group led by Boston investor Jeffrey Vinik said Wednesday it cut its stake in Applied Magnetics Corp to 782,400 common shares or 3.3 percent from 6.4 percent held previously.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include a net 710,800 common shares sold between January 22 and March 4 at prices ranging from $39.4694 to $56.9481 per share.
Applied Magnetics, based in Goleta, Calif., makes magnetic recording heads for computer peripheral equipment.
